_about: Allow-list for the stuck-frame watchdog (tools/harness/watchdog.py, docs/tests/WATCHDOGS.md).
static_ok: screens that are legitimately static while presses go in. Each entry names a route and a frame
stretch (from/to, boot.exe frames) or a picture hash (sha256 of the top and bottom PPM bytes), and says why.
Add an entry only after looking at the screen; an entry never excuses a crash, a hang or a soft-lock.
